地元の川からホタルの姿が消えた。昔は川いっぱいに飛んでいたと聞いていた。: The fireflies disappeared from the local river. I had heard that they once filled the whole river as they flew.
クマの出没で遠足が中止になり、代わりに体育館でレクリエーションをした。: The field trip was canceled due to bear sightings, and we did recreational activities in the gym instead.
孫と虫取りに出かけたが、昔に比べて虫がずいぶん少なくなっていた。: I went bug-catching with my grandchild, but there were far fewer insects than in the old days.
防衛費の増額と、その財源をどうするかという議論が続いた。給与明細の控除の欄を前よ: Debate continued over raising defense spending and how to fund it. I started paying more attention to the deductions line on my pay slip.
ミサイル発射の速報でスマホの警報が一斉に鳴った。まわりの人がみな手を止めて画面を: Missile launch alerts blared on all phones at once. Everyone around me stopped what they were doing and stared at their screens.
近くの基地に新しい部隊が配備され、訓練の音が夜まで聞こえるようになった。: A new unit was deployed to the nearby base, and the sounds of training could be heard late into the night.
災害派遣や訓練の応援が重なり、休日の呼び出しが増えた。家族との予定は何度も流れた: Disaster relief and training support piled up, and I was called in on days off more often. Plans with my family fell through again and again.
自治体の国民保護訓練に参加し、近くの避難先になる地下施設の場所を初めて知った。: I took part in the local government’s civil protection drill and learned for the first time where the underground facility to be used as a nearby shelter was.
駅の構内に「緊急一時避難施設」の表示が増えた。毎日使う地下鉄の駅がその一つだと知: More “emergency temporary shelter” signs appeared inside stations. I learned that the subway station I use every day was one of them.
近隣の国際情勢が緊張したというニュースで株価が急落し、資産が一時的に目減りした。: News of rising tensions in the regional situation sent stock prices plunging, and my assets temporarily lost value.
離島の住民の避難計画が作られ、島外への避難には何日もかかると説明会で聞いた。: An evacuation plan was drawn up for residents of remote islands, and at the briefing I heard that evacuating off the island would take several days.
国際情勢の緊張で輸入品が値上がりし、身近な品物の値札が次々と張り替えられた。: Tension in the international situation pushed up the price of imported goods, and the price tags on everyday items were replaced one after another.
取引先の海外拠点のリスク点検が始まり、代わりの調達先探しで残業が続いた。: A risk review of the client’s overseas sites began, and I worked overtime searching for alternative suppliers.
自衛隊の募集広告を街でよく見かけるようになった。募集人数を集めるのが難しいと報じ: I began to see Self-Defense Forces recruitment ads around town. It was reported that meeting recruitment targets was difficult.
授業で安全保障について話し合ったが、意見は分かれたまま時間切れになった。: We discussed national security in class, but opinions stayed divided and time ran out.
学校から、ミサイル発射時の行動を家庭でも話し合ってほしいとプリントが届いた。: The school sent home a handout asking families to discuss what to do in the event of a missile launch.
経済安全保障を理由に重要物資の国内生産が進められ、職場で扱う製品の品目が変わった: Domestic production of critical goods was promoted on grounds of economic security, and the range of products handled at my workplace changed.
海外からの部品の輸入が止まり、商品の納期を守れなくなった。客に謝る日が続いた。: Imports of parts from overseas stopped, and I couldn’t meet delivery deadlines. I spent days apologizing to customers.
シェルター付き住宅の広告がポストに入るようになった。値段を見て、そっと資源ごみに: Ads for homes with shelters started showing up in my mailbox. I looked at the price and quietly put it out with the recycling.
海外の紛争の映像を毎日のように見ているうちに、遠い国の話だとは思えなくなった。: After watching footage of overseas conflicts almost every day, I could no longer think of it as something happening in a faraway country.
自宅の近くに防衛関連の施設を造る計画が決まった。住民説明会では賛成と反対の両方の: A plan to build a defense-related facility near my home was decided. At the residents’ briefing, there were voices both for and against.
安全保障を理由に、海外とのデータのやり取りのルールが細かく変わった。仕事の手続き: On grounds of security, the rules for exchanging data with other countries changed in detail. Work procedures gained one more step after another.
近くの基地の滑走路の工事が始まり、夜の騒音が増えた。夫婦で相談して、寝室の窓を二: Runway construction began at the nearby base, and nighttime noise increased. My spouse and I talked it over and put double windows in the bedroom.
地元の港や空港が有事の利用も想定して整備されることになり、工事車両が行き交うよう: Local ports and airports were to be upgraded with wartime use in mind, and construction vehicles began passing back and forth.
役所の窓口が予約制になり、予約はスマホからしかできなかった。問い合わせの電話はず: The city hall counter switched to appointments only, and bookings could only be made from a smartphone. The inquiry line was always busy.
近くの銀行の支店が閉まり、残高の確認にはアプリを使うよう言われた。紙の通帳には手: The bank branch nearby closed, and I was told to use the app to check my balance. Paper passbooks began to carry a fee.
病院の会計が自動精算機になり、操作が分からず後ろに長い列ができた。: The hospital payment switched to a self-service machine, and I couldn’t work it out, so a long line formed behind me.
病院の受付で保険証の確認に暗証番号を求められたが、思い出せなかった。後ろで待つ人: At the hospital reception, I was asked for a PIN to verify my insurance card, but I couldn’t remember it. The looks from the people waiting behind me were hard to bear.
近所の店が現金お断りになり、財布に残った小銭の使い道がなくなった。: A nearby shop stopped accepting cash, and the coins left in my wallet had nowhere to be used.
地域のバスの時刻表が紙で配られなくなり、アプリで見るよう言われた。山あいでは電波: Paper timetables for the local bus stopped being handed out, and I was told to check the app. There was no signal in the mountain area.
学校の連絡がすべてアプリになり、通知を見落として子どもに持ち物を忘れさせてしまっ: All school communications moved to an app, and I missed a notification and let my child forget what to bring.
孫とビデオ通話がしたくて、スマホ教室に通い始めた。3回目でやっと画面に孫の顔が映: I wanted to video-call my grandchild, so I started going to a smartphone class. On the third lesson, my grandchild’s face finally appeared on the screen.
通信料を節約していたら、行政の申請も求人の応募もネットが前提で、何度も図書館のパ: I was trying to save on data costs, but government applications and job applications all assumed internet access, so I went to the library computers again and again.
配偶者が全部やっていたネットの手続きが分からず、口座のパスワードもどこにも見つか: I couldn’t figure out the online procedures my spouse used to handle, and I couldn’t find the account password anywhere.

学校の端末の更新が予算不足で遅れ、授業中に半分の端末が起動しなかった。: School device upgrades were delayed due to budget shortfalls, and half the devices wouldn’t start during class.
親のスマホの設定を頼まれ、帰省のたびに半日はそれで終わった。電話での説明はいつも: I was asked to set up my parents’ smartphones, and every visit home, half a day went to that. Explaining over the phone always got stuck partway.
請求書の電子化に合わせて会計ソフトを入れた。慣れるまで、帳簿付けに倍の時間がかか: I installed accounting software to match the move to electronic invoicing. Until I got used to it, bookkeeping took twice as long.
駅の有人窓口が減り、切符の買い方が分からない人が券売機の前で立ち尽くしていた。: Staffed ticket windows at stations decreased, and people who didn’t know how to buy tickets stood frozen in front of the ticket machines.
災害情報はアプリで受け取るよう勧められたが、通知の設定が分からないままにしていた: I was encouraged to receive disaster information through an app, but I left the notification settings unsorted because I didn’t understand them.
介護記録がタブレット入力になり、機械が苦手な同僚の分まで入力を手伝った。: Care records moved to tablet entry, and I helped enter data for coworkers who were bad with machines.
